description: Na₂Y(CO₃)F₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two O and four F atoms. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and one longer (2.50 Å) Na-O bond length. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.66 Å. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.46 Å) Na-F bond length. Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to three O and six F atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.51 Å. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.40 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.27-1.33 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Y, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one C atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two Na and two equivalent Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Y atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Na and two equivalent Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra.
